integrity: Universal equivalence established analytically using a two-variable Hessian and a one-dimensional optimization; finite numerical checks are corroboration, not exhaustive verification.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar-coordinate strict contractions on K ⊕_p Y for arbitrary nonzero Banach Y; 0≤λ<1. Complex dilation equivalence uses the precise ℓ₂-complemented definition in the cited paper. Distinct notions of dilation and general rank-one operators are not classified.
title: Sharp scalar-defect thresholds on \(\ell_p\)-sums
